description:
Alternatives to mainstream shopping that have a cited basis: employee-owned, cooperative, credit union,
    B Corp or family-owned sellers. structure filters by kind (for example 'employee-owned', 'cooperative',
    'credit union', 'b corp'); query filters by words in the name or the category it substitutes for
    (for example 'grocery' or 'hardware'). Each result carries the source that backs it. Not ranked by commission.
name: browse_alternatives
title: Browse cited alternatives
